bio: Keeps the Company's pay-table on the moor-road and the map of eleven bad stretches that the oldest soldiers say used to show three.
context_line: Odric pays the column by the cairn count and wants a stretch re-marked whose bands no longer match the thin.
dialogue_hostile: The Companies pay for surveys, not for questions.
dialogue_warm: Walk the stretch past the split stone with me. Count the bands, then tell me what you felt.
hook_summary: Hires the party to re-mark a stretch whose cairns no longer match the thin streaks.
